entries.definition: Accepts an invitation, creating the identity's membership.
entries.authority: Transitions a valid PENDING Invitation to ACCEPTED, renders its acceptance secret unusable, and requests membership creation through the Organization-owned CreateMembership command boundary; performs no direct Membership write.

entries.definition: Creates a distinct exact-version Assignment for a learner within current authorized scope.
entries.authority: Creates Assignment records linking content to learners.
entries.input: selected organizationId,locationId,target IdentityId,ContentPackId,exact ContentVersion; client IdempotencyKey
entries.idempotency: CLIENT_SUPPLIED; exact-key replay returns original; same key/different payload rejects; new deliberate key creates distinct Assignment
constraints: Ordinary manager calls require current direct-report intersection and scoped manager capability (existing org_admin policy is unchanged but receives no demo grant). The only other caller is automation:demo-admission-v1 through BeginDemoRun fresh-run orchestration for exactly the initial synthetic assignment, under the parent package explicit internal policy, never manager impersonation. Exact content owner equals selected organization.

Assignment + receipt + required AuditEvent + Assignment creation LifecycleEvent are atomic. At most 10 total assignments per DemoRun; a fresh command at cap returns PRECONDITION_FAILED before side effects. Exact-key replay is resolved before quota, so replay at cap returns its original effect.

The admission orchestrator supplies an explicit IdempotencyKey as caller to AssignContent; no server-default fallback or secret/session result enters the receipt. Namespace uses canonical actor reference (human identity or exact admitted principal), never an assumed human identity for AutomationActor.

entries.definition: Authenticates an identity's credential and establishes a session.
entries.authority: Creates ApplicationSession; reads Identity and Credential.

entries.definition: Changes an identity's credential.
entries.authority: Changes an identity credential; when authorized by an ACTIVE SetupToken or PasswordResetToken, consumes that token in the same transaction; revokes sessions per the session-revocation policy.

entries.definition: Transitions one ACTIVE session to COMPLETED after all required responses are persisted.
entries.authority: Transitions LearningSession to completed.
entries.input: scope selector and LearningSessionId; no claimed completion count, correctness or key
entries.idempotency: STATE_GUARDED; second completion returns CONFLICT with no second success effect
constraints: Current LOCATION learner grant and own-session binding; lock same session as event append.
All ordered block responses must already be persisted; correctness is not the gate.
Session transition and required completion AuditEvent are atomic; no candidate LearningSessionCompleted emission.

entries.definition: Creates the single canonical ApplicationSession after ordinary authentication or exact BeginDemoRun/SwitchDemoPersona proof.
entries.authority: Creates ApplicationSession.
constraints: Same existing random cookie/verifier/lifecycle; new allowed callers only, no alternate authentication token.

entries.definition: Creates a new application identity.
entries.authority: Creates Identity and its primary Credential.

entries.definition: Creates a membership linking an identity to an organization.
entries.authority: Creates Membership.
constraints: Existing callers preserved; BeginDemoRun permitted only for its fresh-run fixed persona scopes.

entries.definition: Deactivates an identity for a reason other than offboarding.
entries.authority: Transitions Identity ACTIVE -> INACTIVE; emits IdentityDeactivated.

entries.definition: Deactivates a membership.
entries.authority: Transitions Membership ACTIVE -> INACTIVE.

entries.definition: Invites a prospective identity to join.
entries.authority: Creates a PENDING Invitation with an Invitation-owned hashed acceptance secret and the canonical 7-day expiry; creates no membership.

entries.definition: Issues a certification to an identity.
entries.authority: Creates Certification.

entries.definition: Offboards an identity.
entries.authority: Transitions Identity to INACTIVE; revokes sessions, credentials, and memberships; emits IdentityOffboarded.

entries.definition: Creates one validated immutable published content version through the admitted synthetic demo control plane.
entries.authority: Transitions ContentPack to published state.
entries.input: canonical content payload, expected digest; scope/actor from admitted demo control-plane context
entries.idempotency: SERVER_DERIVED immutable (organizationId, contentPackId, exact version); identical digest returns existing, different digest conflicts
constraints: Only automation:demo-admission-v1 in BeginDemoRun fresh-run transaction may publish the frozen synthetic template. No mounted route and no general customer publisher capability; no DevelopmentAgent runtime grant.
First successful creation appends required publication AuditEvent in same transaction.

entries.definition: Reactivates a deactivated identity.
entries.authority: Transitions Identity INACTIVE -> ACTIVE; emits IdentityReactivated.

entries.definition: Reconciles an ambiguous external effect before retry.
entries.authority: Reads canonical provider state for an OPEN ReconciliationRecord and resolves it only to CONFIRMED_SUCCESS or CONFIRMED_NO_EFFECT; never retries while unresolved.

entries.definition: Validates and appends one server-evaluated learner response while its session is ACTIVE.
entries.authority: Appends ProgressEvent to a LearningSession.
entries.output: ProgressEvent DTO including server evaluation and current session progress facts
entries.idempotency: CLIENT_SUPPLIED; receipt replay never inserts a new learner event
constraints: Current LOCATION learner grant and own-session binding.
Session row lock orders progress vs completion; validate next block, evaluate server-side, persist event and receipt in same transaction.
Success audit is not required by default; do not emit candidate ProgressRecorded.

entries.definition: Revokes an application session before expiry.
entries.authority: Transitions ApplicationSession to revoked; emits ApplicationSessionRevoked.

entries.definition: Revokes a certification.
entries.authority: Transitions Certification to revoked; emits CertificationRevoked.

entries.definition: Revokes a pending invitation and renders its acceptance secret unusable.
entries.authority: Transitions Invitation PENDING -> REVOKED and invalidates the Invitation-owned acceptance secret in the same transaction.

entries.definition: Revokes a membership.
entries.authority: Transitions Membership INACTIVE -> REVOKED; emits MembershipRevoked.

entries.definition: Revokes a single-use token before expiry.
entries.authority: Transitions an ACTIVE SetupToken or PasswordResetToken to REVOKED; subsequent use is rejected.

entries.definition: Creates the sole LearningSession for one authorized Assignment.
entries.authority: Creates LearningSession; emits LearningSessionStarted.
entries.input: scope selector, AssignmentId, client IdempotencyKey; no learner ID or session ID
entries.idempotency: CLIENT_SUPPLIED; same-key replay original; independent key against already-started Assignment conflicts
constraints: Current LOCATION learner grant and own-assignment binding, not membership-skipping SELF.
Session + receipt + required start AuditEvent are atomic; no candidate LearningSessionStarted emission.
